name: Project Scaffold & Configuration
description: Initializes the Vite + React 18 + TypeScript project via bun create vite. Produces a deterministic set of configuration file artifacts (package.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig*.json, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, index.html, src/index.css, src/main.tsx, .env.local.example, convex/ stub) that serve as the foundation for all downstream components. Configures dev server on port 4000, Tailwind CSS v3 with custom theme tokens (fonts, colors, grid utility), React Router v6 and Convex dependencies, vitest in jsdom environment, and @/ path alias. Ensures bun.lockb is the sole lockfile.

functions.name: generate_scaffold
functions.description: Produces the complete set of file artifacts, dependency declarations, and configuration metadata for the project scaffold. This is a pure computation: it takes a ScaffoldConfig and returns a ScaffoldResult without writing to disk. The returned ScaffoldResult contains every file with its exact content, enabling deterministic and testable scaffold generation.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Full scaffold configuration. Callers should use the canonical defaults: project_name='exemplar-docs', server.port=4000, server.strict_port=true, build.out_dir='dist', vitest.environment='jsdom', vitest.globals=true, path_aliases=[{alias:'@/', target:'src/'}], env_vars=[{name:'VITE_CONVEX_URL', ...}].

functions.name: write_scaffold
functions.description: Takes a ScaffoldResult and writes all file artifacts to the target directory on disk, then runs 'bun install' to produce bun.lockb and install node_modules. Ensures no npm/yarn lockfiles exist after completion. This is the effectful complement to generate_scaffold.

inputs.description: Absolute or relative path to the project root directory where files will be written.

inputs.name: scaffold
inputs.description: The scaffold result from generate_scaffold. Must be a complete, valid ScaffoldResult.

inputs.name: force_overwrite
inputs.description: If true, overwrite existing files in target_dir. If false, fail if target_dir contains any files that would be overwritten and whose FileArtifact.overwritable is false.

error_cases.name: directory_not_empty
error_cases.condition: target_dir contains non-overwritable files and force_overwrite is false

error_cases.name: bun_not_found
error_cases.condition: bun executable is not found on PATH

error_cases.name: bun_install_failed
error_cases.condition: bun install exits with non-zero code

error_cases.name: file_write_failed
error_cases.condition: OS-level file write fails (permission denied, disk full, etc.)

preconditions: target_dir is a valid writable directory path
scaffold is a complete ScaffoldResult (all required files present)
bun executable is available on PATH
postconditions: All files from scaffold.files exist at target_dir/<file.path> with exact content
bun.lockb exists at target_dir/bun.lockb
node_modules/ directory exists at target_dir/node_modules/
No package-lock.json exists at target_dir/
No yarn.lock exists at target_dir/
File permissions are set to 0644 for regular files
Directories are created recursively as needed (e.g. src/, convex/)

performance_budget.complexity: O(n) where n is the number of files + dependencies

functions.name: verify_scaffold
functions.description: Runs all verification checks against an existing scaffold installation in the target directory. Each check is independent: failure of one check does not prevent others from running. Checks include: bun install success, lockfile exclusivity, dev server on port 4000, build producing dist/, vitest running in jsdom, all Tailwind theme tokens compiling, path alias resolution, convex directory existence, and .env.local.example presence.

inputs.name: target_dir
inputs.description: Path to the project root directory to verify.

error_cases.condition: target_dir does not exist or is not a directory

error_data.detail: No package.json found — is this a scaffold directory?

error_cases.condition: bun executable is not found on PATH

preconditions: target_dir exists and contains a scaffold installation (package.json present)
bun executable is available on PATH
postconditions: result.checks contains one VerificationCheck for each variant in VerificationCheckName enum (18 checks)
result.all_passed == true if and only if every check in result.checks has passed == true
No files in target_dir are modified by verification (read-only inspection where possible)
Dev server started for port check is terminated before function returns

Runs 'bun run build' to verify build output
Runs 'bun run test --run' to verify vitest execution

structured_side_effects.description: Reads configuration files and build output to verify correctness.

invariants: bun is the sole package manager: no npm, yarn, or npx invocations are ever used
bun.lockb is the only lockfile; package-lock.json and yarn.lock must never exist in the project root
Dev server always binds to port 4000 with strictPort: true — no fallback to alternative ports
Build output is always written to dist/ relative to project root
All TypeScript imports using @/ resolve to the src/ directory
The Tailwind theme tokens (font-serif, font-mono, font-sans, bg-background, bg-grid) are globally available to all components via className
index.html always loads Instrument Serif, JetBrains Mono, and Inter via Google Fonts CDN links
Body background color is always #0a0a0a (near-black) set via @layer base
The .bg-grid utility class is always available via @layer utilities or Tailwind plugin
vitest runs in jsdom environment with globals enabled
All file artifacts are deterministic: the same ScaffoldConfig always produces the same ScaffoldResult
The convex/ directory always exists with at least a stub schema.ts file

data_access.rationale: Reads and writes project configuration files (package.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig*.json, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, index.html, src/index.css, src/main.tsx, .env.local.example, convex/schema.ts) which are all PUBLIC-tier source code artifacts committed to version control. The .env.local.example contains only placeholder values, not actual secrets. During verification, reads build output (dist/) which is also PUBLIC-tier. No PII, secrets, or INTERNAL data is accessed.

side_effects.rationale: Writes deterministic configuration file artifacts to the project directory. All files are public source code.
bun install produces the binary lockfile and installs npm packages to node_modules/. Both are derived from the public package.json manifest.
bun install fetches package tarballs from the public npm registry (registry.npmjs.org) to populate node_modules/.
Verification runs bun subprocesses to confirm the scaffold is functional. All subprocess commands are deterministic and operate on public project files.

authority.rationale: project_scaffold is the single authoritative source for all foundational project configuration. It owns the build toolchain setup (Vite, TypeScript), the Tailwind CSS theme definition (font families, colors, utility classes), the complete npm dependency manifest with pinned versions, the @/ path alias mapping, the dev server port/strictPort configuration, and the vitest test runner configuration. All downstream components depend on these configurations being established exactly as specified by this component. No other component may modify package.json dependencies, vite.config.ts, tsconfig*.json, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, or the Tailwind theme tokens without coordinating through this component's contract.
